Manifest.Name: 拾荒工具升级 / Scavenging Tool Upgrades
Manifest.Author: QZK
Manifest.Description: 六种拾荒工具默认使用对应材料升级，可分别改用同类工具。手电筒使用垃圾，搜索仪沿用原版规则。博士对三种可升级新增工具各按35%概率补货，同类工具模式补到上限，材料模式补到持有一件。化工回收面具使用滤罐可额外获得普通及受管制化学用品（基础20%及5%，升级最高50%及10%，可在设置里切换为用同类面具升级）。滤罐补货概率60%，每枚支持三个实际使用的拾荒夜晚。卸载前出售新增物品。 / Six scavenging tools use matching materials by default. Each can switch to using another copy of the tool. The flashlight uses junk and the scanner keeps its vanilla upgrade. Dr. Jackson has a 35% restock chance for each upgradeable custom tool until you reach its cap in tool mode or own one in material mode. Respirator chances start at 20% common and 5% restricted and can be upgraded to 50% and 10%. The settings can switch from chemical supplies to matching respirators. Filters have a 60% stock chance and last three used scavenging nights.
